name: Exp_WeightOscillator_Direct
summary: This EA trades based on the Weight Oscillator indicator, generating entry signals from direct oscillator readings. It opens buy positions when the weighted oscillator crosses above a threshold and sell positions when it crosses below, applying fixed lot sizing and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于权重振荡器指标进行交易，根据振荡器直接读数生成入场信号。当权重振荡器上穿阈值时开多仓，下穿阈值时开空仓，采用固定手数和可配置的止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于权重振荡器（Weight Oscillator）的动量信号进行交易决策。权重振荡器通过综合多个不同周期和权重的技术指标值，生成一个综合动量判断。入场条件为：当权重振荡器值上穿设定阈值时开多单，下穿阈值时开空单。出场条件依赖可配置的止损和止盈水平，以及可能存在的振荡器反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，没有马丁格尔或网格策略，但缺乏根据账户风险比例自动计算仓位的功能。整体策略逻辑清晰但相对单一，依赖单一指标的信号质量。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals generated by the Weight Oscillator indicator. The Weight Oscillator synthesizes values from multiple technical indicators with different periods and weights to produce a composite momentum reading. Entry conditions are straightforward: a buy position is opened when the weighted oscillator crosses above a configured threshold, and a sell position is opened when it crosses below the threshold. Exit conditions rely on configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, as well as potential oscillator reverse crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management is relatively simple, lacking martingale or grid components, but also missing dynamic position calculation based on account risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively one-dimensional, relying on the signal quality of a single composite indicator.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; close on cumulative profit

parameters.name: BuyThreshold
parameters.description: 买入阈值，振荡器上穿此值开多
parameters.description_en: Buy threshold; oscillator crossing up triggers long

parameters.name: SellThreshold
parameters.description: 卖出阈值，振荡器下穿此值开空
parameters.description_en: Sell threshold; oscillator crossing down triggers short

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，基于多指标综合的权重振荡器信号，比单一指标更可靠
采用固定手数交易，无马丁格尔或网格风险，风险可控
参数可配置性强，阈值、止损止盈、周期等均可调整，便于优化
pros_en: Clean and straightforward strategy logic based on a multi-indicator composite weight oscillator, more reliable than single indicator signals
Fixed lot sizing without martingale or grid risk, keeping risk exposure controllable
Highly configurable parameters including thresholds, stop-loss/take-profit, and periods, facilitating optimization
cons: 依赖单一综合指标信号，缺乏多维度确认机制，可能在震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号
仓位管理过于简单，固定手数未考虑账户规模和波动率，无法实现动态风险管理
未设置新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓，增加过度交易风险
cons_en: Relies on a single composite indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Position sizing is overly simplistic with fixed lots, ignoring account size and volatility, unable to implement dynamic risk management
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar, increasing overtrading risk
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H1信号触发时检查H4趋势方向是否一致
实现动态仓位计算，根据账户余额比例和ATR波动率自动调整交易手数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., check H4 trend alignment before acting on H1 signals
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage and ATR volatility for adaptive risk management

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线内重复入场导致过度交易
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小额账户可能承受过大风险比例
单一指标信号在震荡市中容易频繁触发止损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries within the same bar leading to overtrading
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, potentially exposing small accounts to excessive risk percentages
Single indicator signals can trigger stop-losses frequently in choppy/ranging markets
